mechanism: RTN4 shapes the tubular ER; its loss alters ER morphology and severely compromises SOCE, and the paper ties that to the STIM1-ORAI1 coupling step (claim stated in the title, supported in the body by the loss-of-function phenotype)
sentence: Reticulon 4 is necessary for endoplasmic reticulum tubulation, STIM1-Orai1 coupling, and store-operated calcium entry.
justification: The shape of the ER as a precondition for SOCE: no tubules, no STIM1-ORAI1 coupling. The junction is not only built by tethers, it needs the organelle in the right geometry.

mechanism: thapsigargin and thrombin enhance the association of Homer1 with STIM1 and ORAI1 in human platelets, in a Ca2+-dependent manner
sentence: In addition, thapsigargin and thrombin enhanced the association of Homer1 with STIM1 and Orai1 in a Ca2+-dependent manner.
justification: A scaffold recruited to STIM1 by the very calcium signal it helps produce, in primary human platelets rather than a cell line.

mechanism: same stimulus-dependent association, measured in human platelets
sentence: In addition, thapsigargin and thrombin enhanced the association of Homer1 with STIM1 and Orai1 in a Ca2+-dependent manner.
justification: The channel side of the Homer1 scaffold.

mechanism: direct interaction between Golli, a splice product of the MBP gene, and STIM1; Golli modulates store-operated Ca2+ entry
sentence: In the present study we have discovered that Golli can directly interact with the ER (endoplasmic reticulum) Ca2+-sensing protein STIM1 (stromal interaction molecule 1).
justification: A myelin-basic-protein product acting on STIM1: the SOCE machinery is regulated by proteins from well outside the calcium field.

mechanism: SPPL3 associates with STIM1 through at least two independent domains, the transmembrane region and the CRAC activation domain (CAD), and promotes the association of the CAD with ORAI1; the function is independent of its protease activity
sentence: SPPL3 associates with STIM1 through at least two independent domains, the transmembrane region and the CRAC activation domain (CAD), and can promote the association of the STIM1 CAD with Orai1.
justification: An intramembrane protease moonlighting as a STIM1 cofactor, found in a screen for NFAT activators: a non-obvious entry point into the axis.

mechanism: SPPL3 is required downstream of T cell receptor engagement for maximal Ca2+ influx and NFAT activation, and even constitutively active STIM1 variants need it for full activity
sentence: SPPL3 enhances the signal-induced association of stromal interaction molecule 1 (STIM1) and Orai1 and is even required for the full activity of constitutively active STIM1 variants that bind Orai1 independently of ER Ca(2+) release.
justification: The functional half: SPPL3 is needed for STIM1 to couple, even when STIM1 is locked open.

mechanism: lipid-raft ion channel complex of TRPC1, ORAI1 and SK3 driving SOCE-dependent migration of colon cancer cells; the alkyl-lipid Ohmline disrupts it
sentence: Results In the present study, we demonstrate that SOCE promotes migration of colon cancer cell following the formation of a lipid raft ion channel complex composed of TRPC1/Orai1 and SK3 channels.
justification: The same ORAI1-SK3 feedback seen in PMC8699475, here as a three-channel complex with TRPC1 and with a drug that breaks it.

mechanism: dynamic interaction of endogenous hTRPC6 with both ORAI1 and STIM1, or alternatively with hTRPC3, deciding whether the cell uses capacitative or non-capacitative Ca2+ entry; shown in human platelets
sentence: In the present study we found evidence for the dynamic interaction between endogenously expressed hTRPC6 (human TRPC6) with either both Orai1 and STIM1 (stromal interaction molecule 1) or hTRPC3 to participate in CCE or NCCE.
justification: A channel that switches partners: bound to the ORAI1-STIM1 complex it serves store-operated entry, bound to TRPC3 it serves the non-capacitative route.

mechanism: same endogenous co-immunoprecipitation in human platelets
sentence: In the present study we found evidence for the dynamic interaction between endogenously expressed hTRPC6 (human TRPC6) with either both Orai1 and STIM1 (stromal interaction molecule 1) or hTRPC3 to participate in CCE or NCCE.
justification: The STIM1 side of the same switch.

mechanism: super-resolution imaging of ORAI1, STIM1 and septin 4 in living cells: septins do not recruit ORAI1 themselves but set the number of ER-PM junctions and enhance STIM1-ORAI1 interaction inside them
sentence: Here we show by super-resolution imaging of ORAI1, STIM1, and septin 4 in living cells that septins facilitate Ca2+ signalling indirectly.
justification: A third reference for Septin4 at the junction, and the one that says what it does: it makes junctions, it does not recruit the channel.
